warp: shader_body { vec2 d=uv-vec2(.52,.56); vec2 p=uv+d*sin(length(d)*34.-q1)*.002; ret=texture(sampler_main, p).xyz*.992; }
comp: shader_body { vec3 c=texture(sampler_main, uv).xyz; float v=dot(c,vec3(.333)); vec3 paper=vec3(.82,.80,.72), ink=vec3(.12,.14,.15); float ring=smoothstep(.2,.7,abs(sin(length(uv-.52)*42.-q1))); ret=mix(paper,ink,v)*(.9+.1*ring); }
